title: Camp Events
html:
During Baldur's Gate 3, many story related events happen at the Campsite. Below is a list of camp events and their requirements.

Overview

Camp Events are almost always triggered upon initiating a Long Rest, though some happen automatically upon reaching certain trigger points. Sometimes, several events can be queued if all of their requirements are met. If multiple Camp Events are unlocked, they play in order of priority. Some events are mandatory, and are played if the party travel to another Region, although in this case, no Camp Supplies are used upon taking a Long Rest. Partial Rests trigger camp events without expending resources; a useful mechanic in areas with densely packed story events that may otherwise be missed.

Act One

First ceremorphosis-related night

Requirements: None

Cancelled by any of the following:

  • Crossing the Forest river
  • Entering the Grove
  • Third ceremorphosis night

Consequences: This scene takes place before the player ends the evening. Recruited companions contemplate the situation and discuss next steps. While  Wyll and  Karlach have dialogues for this camp event, they cannot be seen in normal gameplay due to them only being recruitable after crossing either of the above locations.

Second ceremorphosis-related night

Requirements:

  • At least one of the following:
    • First night contemplation
    • First ceremorphosis night
    • Entering the Grove

Cancelled by any of the following:

  • Crossing the Forest river
  • Third ceremorphosis night

Consequences: This scene takes place before the player ends the evening. Recruited companions contemplate transforming; many comment that it is strange that no symptoms have shown yet. While  Karlach has dialogue for this camp event, it cannot be seen in normal gameplay due to her only being recruitable after crossing the river.

Third ceremorphosis-related night

Requirements:

  • At least one of the following:
    • Obtaining the quest to find Halsin
    • Learning about the Goblin Priestess from Sazza
    • Learning about the Gith patrol from Zorru

Cancelled by any of the following:

  • 1 long rest
  • Crossing the Forest river
  • Dream Guardian's visit

Consequences: Recruited companions discuss next steps now that the party has a lead for a potential cure. While  Karlach has dialogue for this camp event, it cannot be seen in normal gameplay due to her only being recruitable after crossing the river.

First night contemplation

Requirements: None

Cancelled by any of the following:

  • 1 night passing
  • Leaving the crash site
  • Entering the forest

Consequences: The player character contemplates all that's happened to them and path forward. Origin characters reflect on their backstory.

Astarion sneaks away from camp

Requirements:

  • Recruit Astarion
  • At least one of the following:
    • First night contemplation
    • First ceremorphosis-related camp night
    • Entering the Grove

Cancelled by any of the following:

  • Unlocking Astarion's bite night
  • Learning that Astarion is a vampire through his verbal confession

Consequences: This event happens during one of the earlier Long Rests.  Astarion can be seen sneaking away from camp while the party is asleep.

Astarion tries to bite the player character

Requirements:

  • Recruit Astarion
  • Entering the forest or the second ceremorphosis-related camp scene happened

Cancelled by:

  • Learning that Astarion is a vampire through his verbal confession after entering the Underdark

Consequences: The player character suddenly wakes up and catches  Astarion trying to bite them. Here, it is revealed Astarion is a vampire spawn. The player character can decide whether to let Astarion bite them, kill him, or banish him from the camp. There is bonus dialogue if the player character has spotted the exsanguinated boar Astarion previously drained in the Wilderness, or met with the Gur hunter. If the player character has not yet learned that Astarion is a vampire, this event is automatically played if they travel to the Rosymorn Monastery Trail or Shadow-Cursed Lands.

In multiplayer campaigns, Astarion prioritizes biting the player character who recruited him.

Astarion and the player character have sex

Requirements: Accepting  Astarion's proposal to have sex with him when he offers it.

Consequences: Astarion and the player character share a night of passion. Going through with the night starts a romance with Astarion.

Dream Guardian visits the player character in their dreams

Requirements: Either travelling to the Goblin Camp or going to the Mountain Pass and trigger the Artifact cutscene.

Consequences: First, the player character appears to be very sick. Then  Lae'zel threatens to kill them, as she thinks the player character and everyone else are transforming into Mind Flayers. After talking her down, it is possible to go to sleep. During their dreams, the player character is visited by the Dream Guardian, who vows to protect them and suggests consuming additional Mind Flayer tadpoles to unlock new powers. After this event, the player character is able to unlock Ilithid Powers. This event is also automatically played if they travel to the Rosymorn Monastery Trail or Shadow-Cursed Lands albeit without scene of  Lae'zel threatening to kill them.

Elminster visits the camp to give a message to Gale

Requirements:  Gale being in the party or camp. Finding  Elminster near the entrance to the Shadow Cursed Lands at either the Mountain Pass or after using the elevator in Grymforge and inviting him to camp. This event is notable for triggering during daytime and can also trigger when taking a Long Rest if the party have ignored Elminster in either of his spawn locations.

Cancelled by: Attacking Elminster

Consequences: Elminster gives Gale a message from Mystra about the Orb and stabilizes it.

Gale's urgent need for a Magic Item

Requirements: Attempting to travel to Rosymorn Monastery Trail or Shadow-Cursed Lands without giving Gale a magic item beforehand.

Cancelled by: Giving Gale a magic item

Consequences: If the party rush through through the Wilderness without giving  Gale a magic item, a Long Rest is forced where Gale's urgency requires the party give him an artifact to sustain the Orb. Failing or refusing to do so causes Gale to leave the party permanently.

Goblin celebration

Main article: Goblin Celebration

Requirements: Completing ⁠Raid the Emerald Grove, while siding with  Minthara and the Goblins. Then talking to Minthara to initiate the party.

Cancelled by: Entering Rosymorn Monastery Trail or the Shadow-Cursed Lands.

Consequences: The Goblins appear at camp and throw a party. This event also allows the player character to initiate romantic encounters with the companions at a much lover approval rate compared to otherwise. This event is also the only time a sexual encounter with Minthara can be triggered. It also grants the ⁠Slaughter's Prize to party members with the  Criminal background.

Karlach and the player try to romantically connect

Requirements: Telling  Karlach that the player character really likes her at Medium Approval during the Tiefling Refugees' Celebration.

Consequences: Karlach visits the player character at night and has a romantic talk with them. This event potentially starts a romance with Karlach. Due a bug in the script, this event can only be triggered during the Tiefling Refugees' Celebration.

Lae'zel and the player have sex

Requirements: Accepting  Lae'zel's proposal to have sex with her when she offers it.

Consequences: Lae'zel and the player character share a night of passion. This event potentially starts a romance with Lae'zel.

Mizora appears at camp

Requirements: Having  Wyll in the party and deciding whether to kill Karlach or inviting her to join the party.

Consequences:  Mizora appears at the campsite to deal with Wyll. If Karlach is invited to join the party, Wyll is turned into a devil as punishment for failure to uphold his contract. If Karlach was killed, Wyll is rewarded with the  Infernal Robe instead. After this, more dialogue options for Wyll are unlocked. This event is also played automatically if the party travel to the Rosymorn Monastery Trail or Shadow-Cursed Lands while Wyll is alive.

Owlbear Cub first appearance

Requirements: Encountering the Owlbear mother. Then, finding the Owlbear Cub at the Goblin Camp, freeing him from the Goblins, and inviting him to camp.

Cancelled by: Leaving the Shadow-Cursed Lands

Consequences: The Owlbear cub visits the camp at night and asks for some food. If given some food, one of the companions scares him away. The player character can scare it away themselves as well. The encounter has different options if the player character has  Speak with Animals active.

Owlbear Cub second appearance

Requirements: Offering some food to the Owlbear Cub during its first appearance.

Cancelled by: Leaving the Shadow-Cursed Lands

Consequences: The Owlbear Cub returns and is wounded on one of his legs. If the player character succeeds a skill check to heal him, the Owlbear Cub becomes a permanent Camp Follower. Like the previous event, the options differ using  Speak with Animals.

Owlbear Cub's nightmare

Requirements: Inviting both Scratch and the Owlbear Cub to camp.

Cancelled by: Leaving the Shadow-Cursed Lands

Consequences: The Owlbear Cub has a nightmare about the Goblins torturing him with Scratch comforting him in his sleep. Like the previous event, the options differ using  Speak with Animals.

Raphael's offer

Requirements: Entering the Rosymorn Monastery Trail or Shadow-Cursed Lands without having spoken with  Raphael in any of his spawn locations.

Cancelled by: Allowing  Raphael to speak when he appears in any of his spawn locations.

Consequences: If the player character enters the Rosymorn Monastery Trail or Shadow-Cursed Lands without ever speaking with  Raphael, a Long Rest automatically plays where he appears in camp to make an offer to the party.

Shadowheart and the player character share a romantic evening

Requirements: Asking  Shadowheart to connect some more with her at High Approval or when she offers to share Wine with the player at Medium Approval during the Tiefling party.

Cancelled by: Dating another companion or entering the Shadowfell

Consequences: Shadowheart and the player character share a romantic evening which can result in a kiss. This event can start a romance with Shadowheart. This event only is only triggered if the party long rest in the Wilderness and is not triggered in the Rosymorn Monastery Trail or the Shadow-Cursed Lands; after entering Shadowfell this event can no longer be triggered and the player can no longer start a romance with Shadowheart.

Shadowheart and Lae'zel fight

Requirements:  Lae'zel learns  Shadowheart has a  gith artefact and the party rest in the Wilderness Region.

Cancelled by: Entering Shadowfell.

Consequences: During the night, one of the two is awoken by the other, who holds them at knifepoint (this could be Shadowheart seeking to get rid of Lae'zel or Lae'zel demanding answers from Shadowheart depending on whether or not Shadowheart was saved in the Nautiloid). Things can turn violent, with one possibly killing the other and other party members possibly getting involved. Or they can bury the hatchet. This event only is only triggered if the party long rest in the Wilderness and is not triggered in the Rosymorn Monastery Trail or the Shadow-Cursed Lands; after entering Shadowfell this event cannot be triggered anymore.

Tiefling Refugee celebration

Main article: Tiefling Refugee Celebration

Requirements: Completing ⁠Defeat the Goblins or ⁠Raid the Emerald Grove, while siding with the Tieflings. Then talking to  Zevlor to initiate a feast.

Cancelled by: Entering Rosymorn Monastery Trail or the Shadow-Cursed Lands.

Consequences: Zevlor and the Tiefling refugees appear at camp and start a celebration before leaving for Baldur's Gate. The choices prior to this event determine who appears during the feast. This event also allows the player character to possibly initiate romantic encounters with more than one companion, and at much lower approval rates than otherwise required; it also grants the ⁠Guardian of the Forgotten to party members with the  Folk Hero background.

Wyll appears at camp and threatens Karlach

Requirements: Recruiting  Karlach to the party before recruiting  Wyll.

Consequences: Wyll appears at the campsite and threatens Karlach. This conversation plays out similarly if the party take him to Karlach. He can be easily convinced that Karlach is no devil and can be invited as a companion. It is also possible to kill him or Karlach instead.

Act One Origin specific events

Astarion

Astarion's nightmare

Requirements: None

Cancelled by: The companions knowing that Astarion is a vampire.

Consequences: Astarion dreams about his past with  Cazador Szarr and how the vampire lord forbade him from drinking the blood of sentient beings. When Astarion wakes up, he realizes he is free from Cazador, allowing him to drink the blood of one of the companions. Choosing to do so, prompts a skill check. If Lae'zel, Shadowheart or Wyll are chosen and the skill check succeeds, Astarion is able to feed and must pass a Saving Throw or the affected companion permanently dies. If the skill check fails, they wake up and confront Astarion about his vampirism. If the Persuasion or Deception check are failed, the affected companion leaves the party. Gale always wakes up since Astarion cannot feed on him because of the Orb and Astarion does not bother with Karlach because of the infernal engine in her chest. While Karlach technically can be chosen as the victim and has lines for it if he is caught, doing so requires very specific actions such as not Long Resting until the party return to the Wilderness from the Shadow-Cursed Lands after she gets her second upgrade from  Dammon and avoiding any companion confronting him on his identity.

Dark Urge

Alfira visits camp and is killed by Dark Urge

Requirements: Crossing the Forest river

Consequences:  Alfira appears after initiating a Long Rest. Her dialogue depends on how the party treated her and when they encountered her before. No matter the outcome of the dialogue, she stays the night at the camp, but is killed by the Dark Urge at night. The Dark Urge then has to either hide the body through succeeding a  DC 12 Stealth or Strength Check check or convince their companions they were innocent through succeeding a Persuasion check. The difficulty class for the persuasion check varies depending on whether or not the player character cleaned the blood off and how they chose to do so. It is also possible to blame Astarion if they know he is a vampire. Doing so causes him to lose approval. Alternatively, the player character admit to the murder. This event is also played automatically if they travel to the Rosymorn Monastery Trail or Shadow-Cursed Lands.

If Alfira is already dead or knocked unconscious on the day this event is triggered, the campsite is visited by  Quil Grootslang instead, and she is then killed instead of Alfira. If Alfira was knocked unconscious she later can be met at the place where she was knocked out and, after the camp celebration, can also be encountered in the Last Light Inn in Act Two.

Sceleritas Fel visits the camp

Requirements: Having experienced the previous event.

Consequences:  Sceleritas Fel, the butler to the Dark Urge, appears before them and congratulates them on the murder of Alfira or Quil. He then gives the Dark Urge the  The Deathstalker Mantle as a reward. This event is also played automatically if they travel to another region and no other mandatory camp events are on queue.

Act Two

Kith'rak Voss

Requirements: Visiting Crèche Y'llek then using the Mountain Pass to get to the Shadow-Cursed Lands or returning back to the Wilderness.

Consequences:  Voss arrives at camp and attempts to sway  Lae'zel to his side after the events of the Creche. The player character can push Lae'zel to either agree or disagree, potentially putting her on her Orpheus path.

Raphael visits after killing Yurgir

Requirements: Completing Kill Raphael's Old Enemy.

Consequences:  Raphael holds up his end of the bargain and explains  Astarion's scars to him in exchange for killing  Yurgir. This event is also played automatically after the party leave the Shadow-Cursed Lands.

Visited by Ogres

Requirements: Getting Lump's War horn, agreeing to pay the Ogres and entering Act 2.

Consequences: The Ogres appear in camp, if the player character never called them and never paid their debt.

Act 2 Romance scenes

Gale's Romance scene

Requirements: Gale's romance scene coincides with the scene in which he and the player character have a heart to heart about his task to kill the Absolute by blowing himself up.

Astarion's Romance scene (post-Araj version)

Requirements:

  • Dating Astarion
  • Speaking to  Araj Oblodra with Astarion in the party

Consequences: Astarion reflects on what happened, thanking the player if they supported him or being upset if they convinced him to drink her blood. Depending on the player's actions this results in a toxic breakup, remaining friends, or progressing the romance.

Astarion's Romance scene (post-Yurgir version)

Requirements:

  • Dating Astarion
  • Astarion having made a deal with Raphael (in front of the Mausoleum or offscreen)
  • Killing  Yurgir
  • Raphael visiting camp to reveal the truth about Astarion's scars
  • Having 70+ approval with Astarion
  • Visiting Moonrise Towers

Consequences: Astarion confesses he only romanced the player character because he saw them as protection against Cazador, only to later realize he was actually falling for them. The player character can either return his feelings, continuing Astarion's romance, or stay as friends and end Astarion's romance path.

Karlach's Romance scene

Requirements:

  • Dating Karlach
  • Using a second piece of Infernal Iron to fix Karlach's heart

Consequences: As she is finally able to touch other people, Karlach wants to celebrate by finally having an intimate night with her beloved.

Dream Visitor

Requirements: Going to Moonrise Tower.

Consequences: The Dream Visitor explains their struggle.

Act Two Origin specific events

Astarion

Astarion inspects his scars

Requirements: Long Resting during Act 2

Consequences: Astarion ponders about the scars on his back. The player character can roll an Investigation check to see if they can find out more. If successful, Astarion realizes the scars are written in Infernal, pointing him to look for Raphael. If the player did not learn of his scars, this event plays automatically after the party leaves the Shadow-Cursed Lands.

Dark Urge

Order to kill Isobel

Requirements: Long Resting during Act 2

Cancelled by: Killing  Isobel, letting her get kidnapped before Long Resting or entering Shadowfell

Consequences:  Sceleritas Fel appears before the Dark Urge and orders them to kill Isobel. If they do, they receive another reward.

Killing the Dark Urge's romantic interest or the companion with the most approval

Requirements:  Isobel is either abducted by Marcus, spared by the Dark Urge or survives until after freeing the  Nightsong.

Cancelled by: Leaving the Shadow-Cursed Lands

Consequences: Sceleritas Fel explains to the player character that their insatiable Urge to kill is now being directed toward the person they care for most: their romantic interest or, if they have none, the companion with the highest approval rating. If the player character has multiple active romances, the companion with the higher approval is chosen. Minthara, Halsin, and Jaheira are always excluded as potential targets. Gale is also excluded until Elminster stabilizes his Orb.

After Sceleritas leaves, the player character can try to resist the Urge ( DC 14 Wisdom Saving Throw) and wake the companion, or go to sleep, thereby surrendering to the Urge and killing them.

If the Dark Urge successfully wakes their companion, they can warn them before succumbing to possession by the Urge. Their companion restrains them and tries to calm them down. Afterwards, the Dark Urge can explain to their companion about their urges.

If they do not warn their companion, the Dark Urge kills them. The player character then must make a  DC 25 Deception Check to convince their companions it was an accident. If they fail, the entire camp turns hostile to them.

If the party leaves the Shadow-Cursed Lands, this event is not triggered and the game progresses as if the player character chose to spare both Isobel and their romantic interest or the companion with the most approval.

Obtaining the Slayer form

Requirements: Either killing Isobel, the player character's romantic interest or the companion with the most approval.

Consequences: Sceleritas Fel appears before the Dark Urge and grants them the power to become the Slayer. This event is also played automatically after the party leave the Shadow-Cursed Lands.

Shadowheart

Learning the truth

Requirements: Sparing  Nightsong and Long Resting after  Ketheric is defeated

Consequences: Shadowheart learns the truth of her past from Aylin as well as her parents being alive in the House of Grief before being gifted with  Selûne's Spear of Night. This event is also played automatically after the party leave the Shadow-Cursed Lands.

Wyll

Rescuing Zariel's asset

Requirements: Long Resting during Act 2

Cancelled by: Entering Moonrise Towers

Consequences: Mizora appears to Wyll one night and demands he rescue Zariel's asset in Moonrise Towers. This event is also triggered upon approaching the entrance of Moonrise Towers.

Act Three

Ambushed by vampire spawn

Requirements: Long resting during Act 3.

Cancelled by: Entering Cazador's Palace.

Consequences:  Astarion's siblings attack the party at camp. If Astarion is  downed while at least one of the spawn is alive, on their next turn they teleport away, taking Astarion with them. He can then be found in the kennels of Szarr Palace.

Aradin ambushes the camp

Requirements: Revealing the  Nightsong's location to  Aradin while she's present in camp or fail any of the roll that prevent him from pursuing her.

Cancelled by: Aylin leaving camp to confront  Lorroakan or entering the Morphic Pool.

Consequences: If the player character reveals  Aylin's location to  Aradin or fails any of the checks to prevent him from pursuing her, he and a group of mercenaries appear one night to bring her to Lorroakan.

Astarion romance

Requirements: Romance  Astarion, complete ⁠The Pale Elf

Cancelled by: Entering the Morphic Pool.

Consequences: Romance scene with Astarion depending on the choices made at the end of his personal quest.

If the player character dissuaded Astarion from Ascending, they meet at Astarion's old grave, where he tells the player character that Cazador essentially killed the person that Astarion was before being turned into a vampire. He ends with a hopeful tone, believing that he can finally chase after his own desires, which include the player character. He pronounces it is finally time for him to start living again.

If Astarion did perform the Ascension ritual, he requires the player character become his vampire spawn. This can be optionally preceded by sex, but the scene always ends with the player character being naked while Astarion bites them. If the player character refuses to turn into his spawn, he ends the relationship, chiding that it is their loss to have turned down his "gift".

Emperor dream

Requirements: Learning about  Belynne Stelmane's murder.

Cancelled by: Entering the Morphic Pool.

Consequences: The  Emperor reflects on its past life. The player character can either comfort it or insist they find it a disgusting creature, after which it mentions the player character reminds him of Stelmane. Another option is wishing for a dreamless sleep, which ends the scene prematurely.

Emperor romance

Requirements: Completing ⁠Visit the Emperor's Old Hideout, knowing about Belynne Stelmane's murder.

Cancelled by: Entering the Morphic Pool.

Consequences: The Emperor appears in the player character's dreams and tries to convince the player character into a romance scene. The player character can accept and have sex with it in either its mindflayer or Dream Guardian form. Or they can reject. If the player character tells the Emperor they find its proposition disgusting, the emperor shows them that the alliance it had with Stelmane was actually it dominating her mind, and threatens to do the same to the player character.

Gale romance

Requirements: Romance  Gale, meet with  Mystra.

Cancelled by: Entering the Morphic Pool.

Consequences: Romance scene with Gale. The dialogue options here determine the end of his ⁠personal quest.

Halsin Romance Scene

Requirements: Recruiting  Halsin, accepting Halsin's romance proposal.

Cancelled by: Entering the Morphic Pool.

Consequences: Romance scene with Halsin. May impact some relationships with companions. Astarion, Shadowheart and Karlach accept the player character romancing Halsin. Gale, Minthara, Lae'zel and Wyll insist on remaining strictly monogamous.

Jaheira's and Minsc's reunion

Requirements: Long resting after  Minsc and  Jaheira have been recruited.

Cancelled by: Entering the Morphic Pool.

Consequences: After Minsc is rescued from the Absolute's domination, he and Jaheira have a brief confrontation at camp.

Karlach romance

Requirements: Romance  Karlach. Upgrade her engine twice. Start a Long rest and talk to her when an exclamation mark appears above her.

Cancelled by: Entering the Morphic Pool.

Consequences: Romance scene with Karlach. Karlach and the player character go on a regular date at the Singing Lute, followed with either them sleeping or having sex with each other.

Lae'zel romance

Requirements:

  • Romance  Lae'zel
  • One night passing after Vlaakith's visit
  • Long resting in the Lower City.

Cancelled by: Entering the Morphic Pool.

Consequences: Romance scene with Lae'zel. Lae'zel wakes the player character to show them something, which turns out to be a sunrise. She explains she has learned to appreciate sunrises, as well as many other things that Faerûn has to offer, most important of which is the player character. She asks them if they want to be her romantic partner. If they accept, Lae'zel names them "Source of her joy".

Mizora pact

Requirements: Recruiting  Wyll. Talking with  Mizora on Wyrm's Crossing bridge to Lower City after  Enver Gortash's coronation.

Cancelled by: Entering the Morphic Pool.

Consequences: Wyll has to chose: does he want the pact with Mizora to endure till the end of his life and save his father  Ulder Ravengard, or does he want to break the pact, thereby ensuring his father's death? This is part of ⁠The Grand Duke and ⁠The Blade of Frontiers. If Ulder was instead killed, either by attacking Gortash during his coronation or rushing to the Iron Throne without taking a Long Rest, Mizora's demand instead is changed to either resurrecting Ulder or allowing him to stay dead.

Mizora romance

Requirements: Speaking to  Mizora and allowing her to stay at camp.

Cancelled by: Entering the Morphic Pool.

Consequences: There is an option to have a sex scene with Mizora, potentially ending a relationship with a companion, if already partnered. Shadowheart, Halsin and Astarion (if Ascended during ⁠The Pale Elf) do not object at all. An Astarion who refused Ascension confronts the player character: if the player character is honest, they stay in a relationship with them, but leave if the player character does not take them seriously. Similarly, Karlach issues an ultimatum on whether or not the player character chooses to stay in a relationship. Lae'zel, Minthara, Wyll and Gale leave no matter what dialogue options the player character chooses.

Orin kidnaps a companion

Requirements: Long resting after arriving in Lower City.

Cancelled by: Having already encountered Orin in the sewers.

Consequences:  Orin abducts one of the companions or  Yenna. She then tries to coerce the party into killing  Enver Gortash by threatening to kill her victim should they come for her first. The preceding scene differs depending on who is abducted.

If Lae'zel is abducted, Orin appears as Lae'zel and threatens to kill Yenna, insinuating that the child is actually Orin in disguise. The party can either let her kill Yenna or persuade her into letting her go. Either way, Orin reveals herself and the scene continues as usual.

If Gale is the victim, Orin pretends to be Gale and threatens to use the Orb to blow up the city in hopes of taking the Absolute with him.

If Halsin is the unfortunate one, Orin pretends to be Halsin and says that the corruption of the city causes him to lose control over himself, causing him to turn into a bear and attack Scratch.

If Orin abducted Minthara, she pretends to be her and starts to act overly paranoid, saying Orin could be anyone.

If none of the above are available, Orin pretends to be Yenna and tells the party that she made some stew, which is actually made from Yenna's cat  Grub.

Shadowheart reflects on leaving Shar

Requirements:

  • Complete ⁠Daughter of Darkness
  • Either have  Shadowheart spare the Nightsong or, if having killed the Nightsong, convince her to spare her parents.

Cancelled by: Allowing Shadowheart to kill her parents after she became a Dark Justiciar. Entering the Morphic Pool. Giving Shadowheart to Viconia.

Consequences: After dealing with Viconia and turning away from Shar, Shadowheart stands near a statue of Selûne and reflects on how she feels after permanently leaving Shar. After a brief dialogue, she breaks down crying. The player has an option to hug her. This scene changes based on whether or not she saved her parents.

If her parents are alive, Shadowheart proclaims she is not worthy of being called their daughter after all she has done in following Shar for so long. Her parents then appear and tell her that she is and will always be their daughter and that they are happy she is finally free from Shar. Shadowheart then asks them if they would call her Shadowheart, instead of her real name Jenevelle, as she feels she cannot be that girl anymore, after everything that is happened. Her parents agree and the reunited family hugs.

If Shadowheart allows her parents to die, she grieves their deaths and tells the player she is keeping her name as Shadowheart, rather than retaking the name Jenevelle.

Shadowheart romance - Selûne path

Requirements:

  • Romance  Shadowheart and partner with her in Act 2
  • Shadowheart spared the  Nightsong
  • 40 Approval or higher with Shadowheart
  • Knowing that Shadowheart cannot swim

Cancelled by: Entering the Morphic Pool.

Consequences: Romance scene with Shadowheart. Shadowheart tells the player character that she wants to take a swim in a nearby lake to cleanse herself from Shar's influence, as well as attempting to learn to swim and wants to take the player character along. This scene has two versions, depending if nudity is turned on or not in the accessibility settings.

If nudity is turned off, both Shadowheart and the player character meet at a beach, where Shadowheart asks the player character to get into the water. After a playful swim, the scene cuts to the pair on the beach again, fully clothed, where they start kissing.

If nudity is turned on, Shadowheart asks the player character to strip and gleefully looks on while they do. Both of them then walk into the water and enjoy a swim before returning to the beach, still naked, where they start to have sex.

A minor consequence of this scene is that Shadowheart, after falling into the water following the Netherbrain's defeat, mentions that she was lucky to have learned to swim.

Shadowheart romance - Shar path

Requirements:

  • Romance  Shadowheart and partner with her in Act 2
  • Shadowheart became a Dark Justiciar in Act 2 by killing the Nightsong
  • Complete ⁠Daughter of Darkness by allowing Shadowheart to kill her own parents

Cancelled by: Entering the Morphic Pool.

Consequences: Romance scene with Shadowheart. Shadowheart explains to the player character that she wants to do a Nightfall ritual to gain Shar's blessing. This ritual requires the participants do a wicked deed, followed by a feast. In this case, the wicked dead is smearing  Aylin's blood onto a statue of Selune. This is followed by Shadowheart and the player character having sex.

Vlaakith visits

Requirements:

  • Lae'zel as a companion or player character

Act Three Origin specific events

Dark Urge

Dark Urge receives vision of their true identity

Requirements: Long resting in Rivington or Wyrm's Crossing, without having entered Wyrm's Rock.

Cancelled by: Entering Wyrm's Rock Fortress.

Consequences: The Dark Urge receives a vision which explains they are Bhaalspawn. The tone of the vision depends whether the player character embraced or resisted the Urge in Act Two. If resisted, the vision implies Bhaal is angry with them and that they will likely die at Orin's hands. Orin appears in this dream in slayer form, killing the Dark Urge.

If embraced, the vision is more triumphant, claiming the player character is at the cusp of regaining their birthright, with Orin being the only one in their way. It shows the player character turning into the Slayer, killing her.

This vision also happens without Long Resting, when the Dark Urge enters Wyrm's Rock Fortress for the first time, at which point they faint and experience the vision.

Jaheira confronts the Dark Urge

Requirements: Having experienced the previous vision. Jaheira must be in active party if said vision occurs during Long Rest. If the Dark Urge experience the vision in Wyrm's Rock Fortress, this event triggers upon taking a Long Rest

Cancelled by: Long Resting while Jaheira is not in the party after experiencing the vision or entering the Morphic Pool.

Consequences:  Jaheira confronts the Dark Urge after learning they are a Bhaalspawn. If the previous event occurs during a Long Rest, this one immediately triggers. In this event, Jaheira wakes the Dark Urge up and confronts them about knowing their identity. If the Dark Urge spared both Isobel and their romantic interest or the companion with whom they have the most approval, Jaheira comforts them and encourages them to overcome their urges.

If the Dark Urge has become the Slayer by either killing Isobel or their romantic interest or the companion with the most approval, Jaheira's interaction is much more hostile, declaring that she should have killed the Urge when they had the chance, only barely managing to stay her hand due to the current Absolute crisis. Jaheira can then be intimidated into leaving the party for good. This way, she will not appear after the Dark Urge accepts Bhaal's blessing.

If  Minsc is recruited before the confrontation with Jaheira, then he will be present during this event and act in concert with her.
